_comment: Text for the flyer library (/member-resources/printables/). Branch flyers are made for every file in src/content/branches/ using the `branch` template; {name}, {area} and {meets} come from the branch file. After editing, run `npm run printables` with `npm run dev` going to rebuild the files.

chapter.title: Join the chapter
chapter.headline: Build power where you live.
chapter.body: We're working people organizing across the Sierra foothills for affordable housing, healthcare for all, and an economy that works for everyone. No experience needed.

branch.title: {name} branch
branch.headline: Organize with your neighbors.
branch.body: For people in {area}. Meet other members and help decide what we take on next.
branch._qrLabel: The address printed under the QR code. Shorter than the branch page's own address so it fits; it lists every branch.

howTo: Open the PDF in a browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), Adobe Acrobat Reader, or Preview on a Mac.
Click a line under "Our next event" and type. On half-page and quarter-page sheets, every copy on the sheet updates at once.
Print at actual size (100%) on plain letter paper. Cut along the dashed lines.
Leave the boxes empty to write details in by hand.
rules: These flyers are for chapter and branch events. Keep the fill-in boxes to event details: date, time, place, and a short note.
Don't use them to speak for the chapter on endorsements, positions, or anything the chapter hasn't decided. Ask in Slack or email the chapter first.
Need something different, like a campaign flyer or a new design? Ask in Slack or email the chapter.
